evidence.excerpt: There is no Russian-sector service business, Russian-origin oil trading or new Russia/Belarus investment.

label: 7. Do you have a formal policy and/or program that ensures compliance with requirements of Sanctions?
justification: Question 7 applies because questions 1, 3 and 6 are answered Yes; a group sanctions policy exists.

evidence.excerpt: Group policy applies to all controlled entities, branches and joint ventures. Screen customers, beneficial owners, directors, employees, suppliers, end-users, intermediaries and transactions at onboarding, daily and before payment/shipment against the scenario versions of Poland, EU, UN, UK and OFAC lists. Compliance investigates alerts; transactions are held pending clearance. Quarterly risk review, annual independent audit (last 2026-06-30), annual staff training, escalation and incident records are maintained.
